description: This course provides an introduction to Artificial Intelligence (AI) that focuses on the practical deployment of AI technology and its societal impact. Students will learn to identify viable points of AI intervention in real-world workflows in science and in other sectors, use low-code platforms to prototype AI tools, evaluate the results and the risks, and make trade-offs depending on the context. No programming or mathematical background is assumed.
